text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Opening hook and clear stance","quality":"engaging introduction","description":"It starts with a memorable hook and quickly signals a position, making the essay feel more purposefully framed as an argument."},{"evidence":"Multiple body paragraphs with transitions like \"To begin,\" \"To continue,\" and \"Next,\"","quality":"organization","description":"It is more clearly segmented into an introduction, body, and conclusion, with smoother signposting between reasons."},{"evidence":"Uses quotation from the article about sensors and radar costs","quality":"textual support","description":"It brings in specific details and quotations from the source article to back up its claims rather than relying only on general opinion."},{"evidence":"Explains cost, safety, and legal concerns in separate points","quality":"development of reasons","description":"It develops several distinct objections with supporting explanation instead of repeating the same concern in slightly different words."},{"evidence":"Connects the cost of driverless cars to alternative uses like homes and education","quality":"relevant elaboration","description":"It extends a claim with an additional consequence that helps show why the argument matters beyond the immediate topic."},{"evidence":"Concluding question about changing what works so well now","quality":"conclusion","description":"It closes by restating the argument in a more deliberate way and leaving the reader with a final rhetorical challenge."}]}
